recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Breasts with Fresh Strawberry Salsa
ingredients_raw: 4 (6 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves

steps.text: Pound the chicken breast halves with a meat mallet until 1/2 inch thick. Season with salt and pepper and place into a resealable plastic bag or small baking dish. Whisk together 1 serrano chile, garlic, chili powder, and 2 tablespoons raspberry vinegar in a small bowl. Whisk in the olive oil until incorporated, then pour the marinade over the chicken breasts, squeeze out excess air, and seal. Place into the refrigerator, and marinate for 2 to 3 hours.

While the chicken marinates, toss the strawberries with the mint and sugar in a bowl. Cover, and refrigerate 1 hour, then fold in the remaining serrano chile, red onion, and 2 tablespoons raspberry vinegar. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Let the salsa stand at room temperature for 20 minutes before serving.
Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat, and lightly oil grate.

Remove the chicken breasts from the marinade, and shake off excess. Discard the remaining marinade. Cook the chicken on the grill until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Serve with the strawberry salsa and a dollop of sour cream.

raw_recipe.headline: Grilled Chicken Breasts with Fresh Strawberry Salsa
raw_recipe.description: This is a wonderful grilled chicken recipe that is served with a spicy strawberry salsa. A great go to dish for fresh strawberries when in season!

review.reviewBody: There was a time when I couldn't imagine combining meats with fruits. Not any more, I have learned to love the combination. THIS is GREAT. Every single thing appealed to me. The hot, the sweet, the sour cream. OH!!! If you think you won't like this-well maybe you won't. I plan on this being a work lunch at least 3x's a week.

I combined all the marinade ingredient with some strawberry yogurt and used a bit of strawberry jam and balsamic vinegar in the salsa. This was a very enjoyable way to use fresh strawberries. 
Round two: apparently I missed the fact that I had tried this recipe once already and decided this was a great recipe for some beautiful ahi tuna steaks and fresh strawberries that I had just picked up. I followed the recipe exactly except for using tuna which was a really great combination for us and reducing the recipe by half to make only two portions. I agree with another reviewer that this should be enjoyed fresh.

8.10.20 Scaled this down to 2 servings. I followed the recipe with the exception of using jalapeños and fig vinegar, since I didn't have serrano chilies and raspberry vinegar on hand.. I marinated for about 3-1/2 hours but really couldn't taste much marinade flavor in the chicken. Really enjoyed the fresh strawberry salsa, and it worked exceptionally well as a topping on the grilled chicken. We enjoyed this, and I would make again.

My family loves this recipe! Instead of raspberry vinegar I used raspberry pomegranate salad dressing. I also use cilantro instead of mint. Other recipes that I have found for this suggests adding avocado in the salsa with juice from 1 whole lime. Some add honey instead of sugar. I'm going to try different variations....maybe even add some mango!

A delicious summer recipe! I also didn't have raspberry vinegar so I used a prepared raspberry vinaigrette and substituted mint for cilantro. The chicken was lightly sweet and very tender and juicy, and the combination of sour cream, spicy strawberries with the chicken was delightful. I served it with fresh cut summer corn sauteed with garlic, lime, and topped with queso fresco

We loved this recipe. I can hardly wait to make it again. Using fresh ingredients is the key. I’ve got mint in my garden and wow, it really added great flavor. Couldn’t find the Serrano chile so used jalapeno. I also used some chipotle powder in addition to the chili powder. And my husband is a big garlic fan who thinks you can never have enough garlic. I removed all of the seeds from the chiles, so it was not a hot dish; will probably leave some in for some more heat next time.

This was way different and surprisingly yummy. I used fresh frozen strawberries (they worked great), no serrano peppers on hand so I used jalaps, I strongly dislike mint in my food so I used cilantro like many others and it was wonderful. I will make this one again. It's quick, healthy,tasty, and a perfect use for my bottle of raspberry balsamic =))
Delightful dressing; added more rasp vinegar, less sugar, chipotle chile powder, cilantro, green onions, and cucumbers.

We liked this one a lot! It was certainly a bit different, but most enjoyable. I made 1/2 the recipe, but cut the sugar back to 2 t. instead of 1 T. because I thought it might be too sweet. But, I was wrong - it needed that extra teaspoon and I'll add it next time.

So Good! This is now one of my favorites

I didn't have everything on hand so I used balsamic vinegar in place of the raspberry vinegar and cilantro in place of the mint but I'm sure its great as written as well. Oh, and I also left the serrano seeds in for the extra kick. I don't really like sour cream so I was planning on leaving it off but decided to put a little dab on just to try it and it was amazing, it added a whole other layer of depth to the dish

this was awesome! I didn't have time to marinate but it still turned out pretty good. Since I didn't have time, I had to change a few things...didn't use any of the peppers and used the raspberry vinegar dressing, I changed the 1/4c oil to 1/4c raspberry vinegar and used 2tbsp of olive oil instead. The grocery store didn't have mint so I also used cilantro. This is a definite keeper...thanks
This was easy to make. The salsa was delicious. The chicken was delicious. Together there just wasn't any flavour! Really strange.
Easy and really good!!!!

I love this recipe. I have made it several times and haven't changed a thing! It's a simple recipe but looks and tastes elegant. . The flavors are wonderful and it looks beautiful in a plate. The salsa is also delicious on Salmon. It's a great for company too. Grill the chicken ahead and keep in wa in the oven or refrigerate overnight and warm, covered with foil before serving. :-)
The hubs2be LOVED it! wish I could have marinated the chicken longer but it was still great. Can't wait to try it with other fruit like mango or pineapple.
sorry, my family and I weren't crazy about this one...it was just ok for us. Would rather have chicken with a chili lime mango salsa. thanks for posting though!
Hubby loved this one, I liked it but didn't love it. Next time I'll reduce the sugar or take it out completely as it was too sweet for my taste. Good combination of flavors though.
I've tried this recipe a few time and I keep twee king it . The original salsa is way to sweet for me and the chicken marinade is tame so I don't seed the Serrano chilies.
Loved it! If only I could cut the onions small enough for the kids to actually try it!
This combination of chicken and strawberries really works! Just the right amount of spiciness, the mint, and red onions balance the sweet strawberries with the chicken.
